title: Slice 4 (Gate execution) phase-1a design — vsdd way: mdatron subprocess client (folded from #14; seeded from captured phase-1a A)

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: CLOSING — DEFUNCT. Operator-flagged + verified: the 'mdatron subprocess client' (captured phase-1a A1-A10) is obsolete. mdatron is now a standalone peer CLI (own package, no library API); vsdd does NOT invoke 'mdatron verify' at runtime — the only vsdd->mdatron touchpoint is preflight.rs checking mdatron is on PATH, plus init.rs deploying .mdatron/ schema+pattern files. Ratified contract 248: 'Hooks: thin Python wrappers invoking mdatron and vsdd; vsdd supplies schemas and patterns, mdatron executes them' = peers, not caller/callee. The REAL Slice 4 (contract 275) = 'Gate execution and the mutation floor' (vsdd's own red-gate/phase-exit gate/terminal-round check/mutation floor; extends Slice 1's vsdd gate), which does NOT wrap mdatron. A1-A10 came from the superseded binary-first plan; its live concerns (pipeline-failure handling, untrusted-quoted) are owned by the hooks + mdatron's envelope contract + the ratified Terminal-output-safety requirement. Real Slice 4 (gate execution) can be designed separately if/when wanted.
